prompt.user:
A channel samples once every 1/8 second, and the transmission signal has a total of 16 different states. The maximum data transmission rate is ().

Choices:
A. 48b/s
B. 64b/s
C. 96b/s
D. 12b/s
E. 4b/s
F. 8b/s
G. 128b/s
H. 16b/s
I. 32b/s
J. 24b/s

Solve the question. At the end, write exactly one final line in this format and do not write anything after it:
Answer: <letter>

response.content:
The channel samples 8 times per second. With 16 possible states, each sample carries:

\[
\log_2(16)=4\text{ bits}
\]

Thus, the maximum data rate is:

\[
8 \times 4=32\text{ b/s}
\]

Answer: I
